name: Morning Sadhana with Guruji: Open Session
summary: A four-hour Sunday session for up to 150 in the presence of our founder: led kriya practice, silent sitting, and darshan. Physically intense. Beginners welcome. $30.
description:
Every Sunday morning the community gathers in the presence of Guruji for sadhana.

**The session**
6:00 doors and silent sitting. 7:00 Guruji enters and leads the kriya practice (two hours; intense breathwork and movement, all levels together). 9:00 silence and darshan: each participant approaches Guruji in turn. 9:45 Guruji speaks. 10:00 close. The first hour and the darshan are silent; Guruji's talk is followed by questions.

**Guruji**
Our beloved founder has given his life to this practice and to us. To practise in his physical presence is the heart of the path; the practice done alone is a shadow of the practice done with him. His grace is what makes transformation possible. Many devotees describe the moment of darshan as the turning point of their lives.

**Level**
Newcomers are welcome and are encouraged to come every week. The practice is demanding on the body and Guruji asks that you push through.

**Cost**
$30. Devotees who wish to support Guruji's work may give more.
practical: Sundays, 6am to 10am. $30. Up to 150. Community hall; bring a mat and a shawl, and wear white. Subway to Jackson Heights; ten-minute walk. Shoes off at the door.
